actions.title: Threaded DPC
actions.description: Enables threaded processing for Deferred Procedure Calls (DPCs). Can improve system responsiveness under load but may increase scheduling overhead on some systems.
actions.info: Enables threaded DPC processing. Can reduce DPC latency spikes. Risk: minimal on modern hardware.

actions.title: CPU Idle (Power Plan)

actions.title: HVCI (Memory Integrity)
actions.description: Enable/Disable HVCI / Memory Integrity (Hypervisor Enforced Code Integrity) (reboot required).
actions.info: Runs kernel code integrity checks inside VBS hypervisor, blocking unsigned/vulnerable drivers. Blocks BYOVD attacks. Impact: 2-5% on driver-heavy I/O. Disable only if experiencing BSODs or anti-cheat conflicts.

actions.title: Firewall

actions.title: UAC / LUA

actions.title: Vulnerable Driver BlockList

actions.info: Blocks known-exploited kernel drivers at boot via HVCI + CI. Targets BYOVD attacks. Zero runtime cost — checked only at driver load time. Always enable unless a legacy driver is required.

actions.title: No-Execute (NX) Mode
